headline: 2026 Induction Class Announced
body: Six new members will be inducted at this year's banquet on October 3rd, including the 1994 girls basketball team.

headline: Nominations Open for 2026
body: The committee is accepting nominations for the 2026 class through January 15th. A name submitted this year stays under consideration even if it isn't selected.

headline: 2024 Banquet Recap
body: Thank you to everyone who joined us to honor the 2024 class. Plaques go up on the wall outside the gym this month.
